clean_title: Kalaignarin All Village Integrated Agricultural Development Programme (KAVIADP)
concise_description: The KAVIADP aims for holistic agricultural development across all Village Panchayats in Tamil Nadu by cultivating fallow lands, enhancing water resources, and distributing farm implements. It focuses on increasing food grain production and farmers' income.

benefits.detail: 100% subsidy for distribution of coconut saplings, horticultural plants, and soil health cards
50% subsidy up to Rs. 50,000 for farm machinery and power tillers
Free solar pump sets for SC/ST small farmers

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Must own agricultural land in targeted Village Panchayats of Tamil Nadu

clean_title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Micro Irrigation Scheme
concise_description: This scheme provides subsidy assistance for installing drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to enhance water-use efficiency in agriculture and horticulture crops. It primarily benefits Small and Marginal Farmers in Tamil Nadu.

benefits.detail: 100% subsidy for Small and Marginal Farmers (up to 2 hectares) and 75% subsidy for Other Farmers (up to 5 hectares)

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Resident farmers of Tamil Nadu cultivating agricultural or horticultural crops with an assured irrigation water source
eligibility_rules.land_or_age_criteria: Small and Marginal Farmers (up to 2 hectares)

clean_title: Chief Minister's Solar Powered Pump Set Scheme
concise_description: This scheme provides a 70% subsidy for farmers in Tamil Nadu to install standalone off-grid solar powered agricultural pump sets for daytime irrigation. It aims to ensure reliable power for irrigation without reliance on the grid.

benefits.detail: 70% subsidy on total cost of 5 HP, 7.5 HP, and 10 HP solar pump sets

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Farmers in Tamil Nadu owning agricultural land with existing irrigation wells/borewells
eligibility_rules.land_or_age_criteria: Must not have an existing free agricultural EB service connection or willing to opt out

clean_title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) - Farm Machinery Subsidy
concise_description: This scheme provides financial subsidies for purchasing agricultural machinery to help offset labor shortages and reduce cultivation costs. It primarily benefits Small, Marginal, Women, and SC/ST farmers, as well as other farmers and rural entrepreneurs.

benefits.detail: 50% subsidy (up to Rs. 1.25 lakh to Rs. 5 lakh depending on machine) for Small, Marginal, Women, and SC/ST farmers
40% subsidy for other farmers
40% subsidy up to Rs. 10 lakh for establishing Custom Hiring Centres

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Individual farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and rural entrepreneurs registered on the Uzhavan / TNAU agricultural engineering portal

concise_description: This scheme provides a special input subsidy package for farmers in the Delta districts of Tamil Nadu to maximize paddy area and yield during the Kuruvai season. It includes benefits such as certified paddy seeds, micronutrients, and bio-fertilizers.

benefits.detail: 100% subsidy on machine transplanting charges (up to Rs. 4,000 per acre)
Certified high-yielding paddy seeds
Zinc sulphate
Liquid bio-fertilizers

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Must be a paddy farmer cultivating Kuruvai crop in Cauvery Delta districts
eligibility_rules.land_or_age_criteria: Maximum up to 1 hectare per farmer

concise_description: The Tamil Nadu Millet Mission aims to increase millet cultivation and improve nutritional security while supporting millet processing units. It provides financial incentives for farmers and women's self-help groups involved in millet production and processing.

benefits.detail: Input subsidy of Rs. 2,000 per hectare for certified millet seeds and bio-inputs
50% subsidy up to Rs. 5 lakh for FPOs and women self-help groups to set up millet processing and value-addition units

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Farmers cultivating millets in designated millet zones of Tamil Nadu

clean_title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Crop Insurance Scheme
concise_description: The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) provides comprehensive crop yield insurance to protect farmers against losses due to natural calamities, pests, and unseasonal rainfall. It aims to financially stabilize farmers suffering from crop loss due to adverse weather conditions.

benefits.detail: Sum insured up to Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 85,000 per hectare depending on notified crop; farmers pay only 1.5% premium for Rabi crops and 2% for Kharif crops.

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: All loanee and non-loanee farmers cultivating notified crops in notified firkas/villages of Tamil Nadu

clean_title: Free Electricity Supply to Agricultural Pump Sets
concise_description: This scheme provides 100% free electricity tariff for registered agricultural pump sets to eliminate the power tariff burden for irrigation of food and cash crops across Tamil Nadu.

benefits.detail: 100% free electricity tariff for registered agricultural pump sets

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Farmers owning minimum 0.5 acres of agricultural land in Tamil Nadu with a valid irrigation well or borewell

concise_description: This scheme provides comprehensive social security for small and marginal farmers and agricultural laborers in Tamil Nadu, covering educational scholarships, marriage assistance, accident relief, and old-age pensions.

benefits.detail: Monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 for destitute farmers aged 60+
Rs. 2,00,000 accidental death relief
Rs. 20,000 natural death assistance
Scholarships from Rs. 1,250 to Rs. 6,500 per year for farmers' children
Marriage assistance up to Rs. 10,000

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Must be a small or marginal farmer owning up to 2.5 acres of wetland or 5 acres of dryland
eligibility_rules.land_or_age_criteria: Small and marginal farmers and registered agricultural laborers aged 18 to 65

clean_title: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC) Youth Entrepreneurship Scheme
concise_description: This scheme empowers unemployed agriculture graduates and diploma holders to establish agri-ventures and soil testing labs, providing extension services to farmers. It offers credit-linked back-ended subsidies to support their entrepreneurial efforts.

benefits.detail: 44% back-ended composite subsidy for Women, SC/ST, and North-Eastern candidates; 36% subsidy for General category candidates on project loans up to Rs. 20 lakh (Rs. 100 lakh for group projects)

eligibility_rules.rule_summary: Must be a graduate or diploma holder in Agriculture, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, Forestry, or Dairy Technology domiciled in Tamil Nadu
